# Data contracts of the protein-engineering pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's guide, [modules/genomics/packs/protein-engineering/guides/protein-engineering.md](../../../modules/genomics/packs/protein-engineering/guides/protein-engineering.md), links each kind here and to its example (tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to how to use the pack and where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| [PROT](#prot-protein-protein) | `protein` | fundamental | active | 8 | 0 |
| [RESIDUE](#residue-residue-residue) | `residue` | fundamental | active | 13 | 0 |

## PROT: Protein (`protein`)

One invented protein: its sequence, family and active site. Four proteins; Helixase-7, the enzyme of gene HLXK7 (312 amino acids), is the one the cohort screen and the design campaign are about.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [protein.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/protein-engineering/contracts/protein.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per protein, keyed by PROTEIN (the symbol of its gene). |
| Key | `PROTEIN` |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `protein-engineering.protein`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `PROTEIN`, `GENE`, `NAME`, `LENGTH`, `FAMILY`, `DESIGN_ROUNDS` |
| Test data | data/testdata/protein-engineering/protein |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PROTEIN` | id | required |  | The protein's id: the symbol of its gene. | `HLXK7` |  |
| `GENE` | id | required |  | The gene that codes for it; opens SGENE. | `HLXK7` | `study-gene` |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The protein's name. | `Helixase-7` |  |
| `LENGTH` | integer | required | amino acids | The amino acids in it. | `312` |  |
| `FAMILY` | text | required |  | The family it belongs to. | `Helicase-like kinase` |  |
| `SEQUENCE` | text | required |  | The amino acid sequence, one letter each. | `MKTAYIAKQR` |  |
| `ACTIVE_SITE` | vector | required |  | The positions of the active site's residues. |  |  |
| `DESIGN_ROUNDS` | integer | required | rounds | How many rounds of design the campaign ran on it; 0 for a protein never designed. | `8` |  |

**Links:** `GENE` → `study-gene`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `PROTEIN`, `GENE`, `NAME`, `LENGTH`, `FAMILY`, `SEQUENCE`, `ACTIVE_SITE`, `DESIGN_ROUNDS`
- unique: key `PROTEIN`; per snapshot
- link: field GENE; kind study-gene
- vector-length: field ACTIVE_SITE; same every row of one business date

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

<a id="example-protein-engineering-protein"></a>
**Example: `data/testdata/protein-engineering/protein`**

A real record, the most complete of the first rows (the one with the most non-empty fields), two-space indents. A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "PROTEIN": "HLXK7",
  "GENE": "HLXK7",

  "LENGTH": 312,
  "FAMILY": "Helicase-like kinase",
  "SEQUENCE": "",
  "ACTIVE_SITE": [
    173,
    177,
    181,
    "… 3 more numbers"
  ],
  "DESIGN_ROUNDS": 8
}
```

## RESIDUE: Residue (`residue`)

One amino acid position of a protein: what it is, where it sits in the fold, how buried it is, whether it is in the active site, its place in space and the mean effect of changing it. Coordinates, burial and the means are written by the generator.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [residue.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/protein-engineering/contracts/residue.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per protein position, keyed by RESIDUE_ID. |
| Key | `RESIDUE_ID` |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `protein-engineering.residue`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `RESIDUE_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `POS`, `SECONDARY`, `ACTIVE_SITE` |
| Test data | data/testdata/protein-engineering/residue |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RESIDUE_ID` | id | required |  | The protein, a colon and the position. | `HLXK7:117` |  |
| `PROTEIN` | id | required |  | The protein; opens PROT. | `HLXK7` | `protein` |
| `POS` | integer | required |  | The position, counted from 1. | `117` |  |
| `AA` | text | required |  | The amino acid there (one letter). | `D` |  |
| `SECONDARY` | text | required |  | The element of the fold it is in. | `helix`, `strand`, `loop` |  |
| `DOMAIN` | text | required |  | The domain it is in. | `N-lobe`, `hinge`, `C-lobe` |  |
| `BURIAL` | rate | required |  | How buried it is, 0 (on the surface) to 1 (deep inside): the rank of its neighbours within 11 angstroms. | `0.83` |  |
| `ACTIVE_SITE` | boolean | required |  | True for the residues of the active site. | `True` |  |
| `X` | amount | required | angstrom | Its place along x. | `4.2` |  |
| `Y` | amount | required | angstrom | Its place along y. | `-11.8` |  |
| `Z` | amount | required | angstrom | Its place along z. | `7.5` |  |
| `MEAN_ACTIVITY` | amount | required |  | The mean activity score of the 19 changes of the position (negative hurts, positive helps). | `-1.42` |  |
| `MEAN_STABILITY` | amount | required |  | The mean stability score of the 19 changes of the position. | `-0.96` |  |

**Links:** `PROTEIN` → `protein`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `RESIDUE_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `POS`, `AA`, `SECONDARY`, `DOMAIN`, `BURIAL`, `ACTIVE_SITE`, `X`, `Y`, `Z`, `MEAN_ACTIVITY`, `MEAN_STABILITY`
- unique: key `RESIDUE_ID`; per snapshot
- link: field PROTEIN; kind protein
- enum: field SECONDARY; values `helix`, `strand`, `loop`
- enum: field DOMAIN; values `N-lobe`, `hinge`, `C-lobe`

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

## CONTACT: Residue contact (`residue-contact`)

## DMS: Deep mutational scan score (`dms-score`)

One measurement of the scan: what changing one position of a protein to one amino acid did to one assay. Every position, every one of the 20 amino acids, two assays: 47,840 experiments.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [dms-score.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/protein-engineering/contracts/dms-score.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per position, amino acid and assay, keyed by SCORE_ID. |
| Key | `SCORE_ID` |
| Id pattern | — |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `protein-engineering.dms-score`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `SCORE_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `POS`, `AA`, `ASSAY`, `SCORE` |
| Test data | data/testdata/protein-engineering/dms-score |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SCORE_ID` | id | required |  | The protein, position, amino acid and assay, joined by colons (the assay in capitals). | `HLXK7:117:P:ACTIVITY` |  |
| `PROTEIN` | id | required |  | The protein; opens PROT. | `HLXK7` | `protein` |
| `POS` | integer | required |  | The position changed. | `117` |  |
| `AA_REF` | text | required |  | The amino acid the protein has there (one letter). | `L` |  |
| `AA` | text | required |  | The amino acid it was changed to; the same as AA_REF measures the unchanged protein. | `P` |  |
| `MUTATION` | text | required |  | The change written as AA_REF, POS and AA. | `L117P` |  |
| `ASSAY` | text | required |  | What was measured. | `activity`, `stability` |  |
| `SCORE` | amount | required |  | The effect against the natural protein: negative hurts, positive helps, 0 no effect. | `-2.31` |  |
| `SE` | amount | required |  | The standard error over the replicates. | `0.12` |  |
| `REPLICATES` | integer | required | replicates | How many replicate measurements went into it. | `3` |  |

**Links:** `PROTEIN` → `protein`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `SCORE_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `POS`, `AA_REF`, `AA`, `MUTATION`, `ASSAY`, `SCORE`, `SE`, `REPLICATES`
- unique: key `SCORE_ID`; per snapshot
- link: field PROTEIN; kind protein
- enum: field ASSAY; values `activity`, `stability`

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

## DESIGN: Protein design (`design`)

One designed variant of Helixase-7 from one round of the campaign: its parent, how many changes it carries, how active and stable it measured, what the model predicted and where it sits on the map of designs. Eight rounds of 1,500 designs climb to a protein about fifteen times as active as the natural one.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [design.contract.yaml](../../../modules/genomics/packs/protein-engineering/contracts/design.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | synthetic: the seeded generator tools/packgen/genomics_showcase/make.py (nothing real: the genes, patients, protein and designs are invented) |
| Grain | One row per design, keyed by DESIGN_ID. |
| Key | `DESIGN_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^DSG-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | static (due: regenerated only when the generator or its seed changes; the same documents on every business day) |
| Binding hint | lake table `protein-engineering.design`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Columns | `DESIGN_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `ROUND`, `ACTIVITY`, `STATUS` |
| Test data | data/testdata/protein-engineering/design |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DESIGN_ID` | id | required |  | DSG-, the protein, the round and the design's number in it. | `DSG-HLXK7-R8-0412` |  |
| `PROTEIN` | id | required |  | The protein designed; opens PROT. | `HLXK7` | `protein` |
| `ROUND` | integer | required |  | The round, 1 to 8. | `8` |  |
| `PARENT` | text | required |  | The design of the round before that is nearest to it on the map; NATURAL in round 1. | `DSG-HLXK7-R7-0988` |  |
| `N_CHANGES` | integer | required | changes | How many amino acid changes it carries against the natural protein. | `3` |  |
| `CHANGES` | text | required |  | The changes written out, in position order; the rows are in design-mutation. | `A117G L203F` |  |
| `ACTIVITY` | amount | required | x natural | The measured activity as a multiple of the natural protein's (1.0). | `15.2` |  |
| `DELTA_TM` | amount | required | degrees C | The melting temperature against the natural protein: positive is more stable. | `5.1` |  |
| `MODEL_SCORE` | amount | required | x natural | The activity the design model predicted. | `14.1` |  |
| `STATUS` | text | required |  | lead for the best design of the campaign, selected for the best 5% of its round, tested for the rest. | `lead`, `selected`, `tested` |  |
| `EMB_X` | amount | required |  | Its place on the map of designs, left to right (0 to 1). Written by the generator. | `0.7412` |  |
| `EMB_Y` | amount | required |  | Its place on the map of designs, top to bottom (0 to 1). Written by the generator. | `0.3196` |  |

**Links:** `PROTEIN` → `protein`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `DESIGN_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `ROUND`, `PARENT`, `N_CHANGES`, `CHANGES`, `ACTIVITY`, `DELTA_TM`, `MODEL_SCORE`, `STATUS`, `EMB_X`, `EMB_Y`
- unique: key `DESIGN_ID`; per snapshot
- link: field PROTEIN; kind protein
- enum: field STATUS; values `lead`, `selected`, `tested`

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

| `BEST_ACTIVITY` | amount | required | x natural | Its activity. | `15.2` |  |
| `MEDIAN_ACTIVITY` | amount | required | x natural | The median activity of the round's designs. | `6.8` |  |
| `TRAPPED` | integer | required | designs | How many designs were caught on the false peak. | `0` |  |
| `NOTE` | text | required |  | What happened in the round. | `The campaign reaches the summit.` |  |

**Links:** `PROTEIN` → `protein`, `BEST_DESIGN` → `design`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `ROUND_ID`, `PROTEIN`, `ROUND`, `METHOD`, `STARTED`, `DESIGNS`, `BEST_DESIGN`, `BEST_ACTIVITY`, `MEDIAN_ACTIVITY`, `TRAPPED`, `NOTE`
- unique: key `ROUND_ID`; per snapshot
- link: field PROTEIN; kind protein
- link: field BEST_DESIGN; kind design

**Notes**

- Synthetic and seeded: the same seed gives the same documents, byte for byte. Nothing in it is real: the gene, protein, patients and designs are invented, and every screen that shows it says so.
- A snapshot: the same documents on every business day of the demo lake.

<a id="example-protein-engineering-design-round"></a>
**Example: `data/testdata/protein-engineering/design-round`**

A real record, the most complete of the first rows (the one with the most non-empty fields), two-space indents. A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "ROUND_ID": "HLXK7-R1",
  "PROTEIN": "HLXK7",
  "ROUND": 1,
  "METHOD": "Scan-guided library: single changes at tolerant positions",
  "STARTED": "2026-03-02",
  "DESIGNS": 1500,
  "BEST_DESIGN": "DSG-HLXK7-R1-0665",
  "BEST_ACTIVITY": 6.34,
  "MEDIAN_ACTIVITY": 1.82,
  "TRAPPED": 0,
  "NOTE": "Mostly small gains: the natural protein is the start."
}
```
